description.value: Close sells a CRM with built-in calling, email, SMS, automation, and AI. Its tagline is 'The CRM that sells with you.'
A sales-focused CRM for startups and small and mid-sized businesses.

product_description.value: Calling, email, and SMS built into the CRM, including a dialer that moves through prioritized lead lists; AI Notes; Agents for drafting follow-ups, updating lead fields, and a Voice Agent that calls, qualifies, and books meetings; Chloe, an AI assistant; Workflows; pipeline and reporting views; 100+ integrations and an MCP server.
Calling, email, and SMS natively inside the platform, plus follow-ups, task creation, lead routing, sales insights, and data reporting. Built-in Power Dialer and Predictive Dialer.

business_model_description.value: Software sold through self-serve sign-up (including Google sign-in); pricing and plan structure are not stated.
SaaS product; pricing not stated in the results.

customer_description.value: Claims 11,500+ sales teams use Close. Named customers and testimonials include Flatiron School, Sales Transformation Group, Posted, Giveffect, Sisu, OutboundSync, 6P Marketing, and followup.com (self-reported).
Primarily serves startups and SMBs looking for a CRM that is easy to implement. Named customers include customer.io, toggl, and Hipcamp.

revenue.value: $13.1M in 2024 (Latka); $17M (Latka, another page); $35.6M (StartupHub estimate, range $25.4M to $47.5M); $25 Million (ZoomInfo)

headquarters.value: San Francisco, CA (350 Townsend St); Palo Alto (StartupHub)
Jackson, Wyoming; San Francisco; Mountain View, California (sources differ)
